title: Divergence: rust-lean-correspondence.md violates its own AC-1 — ref_encode.rs::encode Expr::Field + Expr::TupleProj arms have no table row and no documented residual (and no Lean Expr constructor)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
COMPLETENESS GAP (probe 2, failure mode iii — missing arm). AC-1 of .design/verified/rust-lean-correspondence.md requires: 'every match arm of ref_contract_pred ... appears as a row, OR is recorded as an explicit out-of-Lean-scope residual.'

The encode() dispatch in thermite-tv/src/ref_encode.rs @ 579d3d48 has 14 live arms. Two are absent from Tables 1A-1G AND from the 'What this inspection does NOT cover' / D1-D5 residual lists:

  Expr::Field { receiver, name } => Ok(format!("{r}.{name}"))        (ref_encode.rs::encode, the Field arm)
  Expr::TupleProj { receiver, index } => Ok(format!("{r}.{index}"))   (ref_encode.rs::encode, the TupleProj arm)

Both are reachable in the frozen contract subset: a struct-field ens (result.x == 0) and a tuple-projection ens (result.0 == a) — the latter is exactly the multi-cell-tuple surface the doc itself discusses in Table 3B / D5, but D5 only covers the EXEC-BODY obligation SHAPE (body_ref_state_ensures' result.{i} conjunction), NOT the ref_encode.rs::encode Expr::TupleProj/Expr::Field arms that encode such a projection in CONTRACT position.

The Lean Expr inductive (lean/Thermite/Ast.lean @ 7c85da25, constructors intLit/boolLit/var/cmp/logic/neg/arith/cast/seqVar/strVar/idx/subrange/seqLen/byteAt/comb/optResVar/match_/is_/specCall) has NO field or tupleProj constructor. So these two arms have no Lean model AND no documented residual — the precise (iii) failure mode probe 2 targets.

CORRECTION THE DOC MUST MAKE: add Field/TupleProj either as rows (with their Lean counterpart, if one is added) or as an explicit residual in 'What this inspection does NOT cover' (analogous to D3 Map / D4 guard arms — a Rust-encoder arm with no Lean S_C counterpart, inspection-only). As written the doc's AC-1 self-claim ('every arm ... is a row') is false.

comments.content: FIX PLAN (acto-fixer, doc-only single-file): close the AC-1 completeness gap honestly. ref_encode.rs::encode Expr::Field (result.x -> {r}.{name}) and Expr::TupleProj (result.0 -> {r}.{index}) are live arms with NO Lean Expr constructor (Ast.lean has field/tupleProj nowhere). CORRECT fix is an explicit RESIDUAL, not a fabricated correspondence row. Adding Discrepancy D6 (quoted arms + no-Lean-S_C-counterpart + consequence: per-run Z3 TV only, no T1 backing + future-brick note), Table 1H (exhaustive 15-arm encode inventory: rows or D6 or honest Err catch-all), the residual line in 'does NOT cover', and corrected AC-1/REQ-1 cells. No code/Lean change. lake build + cargo build --workspace stay green.
